open_points.subject: Model M08 — Refusal
open_points.text:
- the models M01 to M07 and their enumerations;
- the two refusal types: a refusal of the whole operation and a refusal of one file.
open_points.question: Does `domain_models` own M08 `Refusal` and its `RefusalCode`, while `deliverer_api` owns only their HTTP representation and fixed message, or does `deliverer_api` own the M08 model itself?
options: `domain_models` owns and exports M08 `Refusal` and `RefusalCode`; `deliverer_api` constructs its HTTP answer
`deliverer_api` owns M08 `Refusal`, while `domain_models` owns only the internal refusal types it exports
open_points.default_guess: Make `domain_models` own and export M08 `Refusal` and `RefusalCode`, and keep HTTP status and serialization in `deliverer_api`.
